name: Netronome
tagline: Monitor, analyze, and alert on network performance.
description: Netronome is a complete network performance monitoring solution with speed tests, continuous packet-loss monitoring, distributed server agents, automated alerts, visualizations, and historical tracking.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  netronome:
    image: ghcr.io/autobrr/netronome:v0.13.0
    container_name: netronome
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
      - /sbin/tini
      - --
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
    command:
      - |-
        config=/data/.config/netronome/config.toml
        if [ ! -f "$$config" ]; then
          netronome generate-config
        fi
        exec netronome serve
    ports:
      - target: 7575
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      TZ: $TZ
      NETRONOME__HOST: 0.0.0.0
      NETRONOME__PORT: 7575
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW
